Mathematical_Formula: del(W * H) / del t + del(W * H * u_bar) / del x = W * a_dot_i = W * (rho_water / rho_i) * a_dot_we
LHS_Units_and_Meaning: m^2 s^-1; rate of change of cross-sectional area plus spatial cross-sectional flux gradient
RHS_Terms_Units_and_Meaning: W: channel width (m); H: solid ice thickness (m); u_bar: depth-averaged velocity (m s^-1); a_dot_i: solid-ice thickness accumulation rate (m s^-1); a_dot_we: water-equivalent SMB (m w.e. s^-1); rho_water: 1000 kg m^-3; rho_i: 917 kg m^-3
Spatial_Domain_Boundary: 1D flowline curvilinear coordinate x in [0, x_GL(t)], from ice divide (x=0) to grounding line (x=x_GL)
Dimensional_Consistency: DIMENSIONALLY RIGOROUS (All terms have dimensions [L^2 T^-1])
Physical_Validity_Notes: DIMENSIONALLY RIGOROUS. Explicitly accounts for density ratio rho_water / rho_i = 1000 / 917 = 1.09051. Net RACMO SMB converted once on staging; zero double-conversion.

Mathematical_Formula: d M_g / dt = SMB_g - D_GL - M_ungrounding;   SMB_g = Integral(rho_water * W * a_dot_we dx) = Integral(rho_i * W * a_dot_i dx)
LHS_Units_and_Meaning: kg s^-1 (or Gt yr^-1); instantaneous rate of total grounded ice mass change
RHS_Terms_Units_and_Meaning: SMB_g: integrated surface mass rate (kg s^-1); D_GL: advective grounding-line flux (kg s^-1); M_ungrounding: boundary transfer rate across moving grounding line (kg s^-1)
Spatial_Domain_Boundary: Grounded basin domain Omega_g(t) bounded by moving grounding line x = x_GL(t)
Dimensional_Consistency: DIMENSIONALLY RIGOROUS (All terms have dimensions [M T^-1])
Physical_Validity_Notes: DIMENSIONALLY RIGOROUS. Grounded SMB integrated mass flux balances advective grounding-line discharge and ungrounding transfer. Disjoint in space-time; zero double-counting.

LHS_Units_and_Meaning: kg s^-1 (or Gt yr^-1); mass rate transferred between grounded and floating categories due to boundary velocity
RHS_Terms_Units_and_Meaning: rho_i: 917 kg m^-3; W_GL: width (m); H_GL: flotation thickness (m); dx_GL/dt: grounding line velocity v_GL (m s^-1)
Spatial_Domain_Boundary: Instantaneous grounding line interface x = x_GL(t)
Dimensional_Consistency: DIMENSIONALLY RIGOROUS (rho_i [M L^-3] * W [L] * H [L] * v_GL [L T^-1] = [M T^-1])
Physical_Validity_Notes: Retreat (v_GL < 0) yields M_ungrounding > 0 (transfer to shelf). Advance (v_GL > 0) yields M_ungrounding < 0 (pinning onto bed).

Mathematical_Formula: q_unbuttressed = [(rho_i * g * (1 - rho_i / rho_w)) / (4^n * A)]^(1 / (m + 1)) * C_bed^(-1 / (m + 1)) * h_GL^((m + n + 3) / (m + 1))
LHS_Units_and_Meaning: m^2 s^-1; volumetric ice discharge flux per unit grounding-line width
RHS_Terms_Units_and_Meaning: rho_i, rho_w: densities (kg m^-3); g: 9.81 m s^-2; n: Glen exponent (3); A: softness factor (Pa^-3 s^-1); C_bed: friction parameter (Pa (m/s)^-m); h_GL: flotation thickness (m)
Spatial_Domain_Boundary: Grounding line boundary layer transition zone x = x_GL
Dimensional_Consistency: DIMENSIONALLY RIGOROUS (Explicit dimensional proof yields exactly [L^2 T^-1] = m^2 s^-1)
Physical_Validity_Notes: Asymptotic boundary layer matching from Schoof (2007) Eq. 32. Original analytical derivation strictly assumes unbuttressed 1D shelf.

LHS_Units_and_Meaning: m^2 s^-1; actual buttressed volumetric discharge per unit width exiting grounding line
RHS_Terms_Units_and_Meaning: q_unbuttressed: Schoof flux (m^2 s^-1); omega_b: maximum embayment buttressing fraction [0, 0.95]; theta_buttress: state variable in [0, 1]; mu: non-linear exponent [1, 3]
Dimensional_Consistency: DIMENSIONALLY RIGOROUS (Bracketed term is dimensionless; preserves m^2 s^-1)
Physical_Validity_Notes: SINGLE AUTHORITATIVE BUTTRESSING EQUATION. Conflicting power-law removed. theta=1 gives steady-state restrained flux; theta=0 gives unbuttressed surge flux.

LHS_Units_and_Meaning: m; solid ice-equivalent thickness required for neutral Archimedean buoyancy in seawater
RHS_Terms_Units_and_Meaning: rho_w: 1028 kg m^-3; rho_i: 917 kg m^-3; z_b: bedrock elevation relative to sea level (m)
Spatial_Domain_Boundary: Evaluated at bedrock profile where z_b(x) < 0
Dimensional_Consistency: DIMENSIONALLY RIGOROUS (Dimensionless density ratio multiplying length [L] yields [L])
Physical_Validity_Notes: Defines the grounding line position: root of Delta z_flot(x) = H(x) + (rho_w / rho_i) * z_b(x) = 0.

Mathematical_Formula: H_geom(x, t) = H(x, t) + FAC(x, t);   s(x, t) = z_b(x) + H_geom(x, t)
LHS_Units_and_Meaning: m; true geometric ice-firn thickness and physical surface elevation above geoid
RHS_Terms_Units_and_Meaning: H: solid ice-equivalent thickness (m); FAC: firn air content (m); z_b: bedrock elevation (m)
Spatial_Domain_Boundary: Across continuous spatial flowline coordinate x
Dimensional_Consistency: DIMENSIONALLY RIGOROUS (All quantities have SI units of meters [L])
Physical_Validity_Notes: Strict separation between solid ice mass (H) and firn-expanded geometry (H_geom, s). Prevents altimetry-to-mass bias.

LHS_Units_and_Meaning: kg m^-2 s^-1 (or m w.e. yr^-1); net solid accumulation flux density entering ice sheet
RHS_Terms_Units_and_Meaning: M_dot_snow: snowfall; M_dot_subl: sublimation; M_dot_drift: wind divergence; M_dot_melt: snowmelt; M_dot_refreeze: internal firn refreezing (all kg m^-2 s^-1)
Dimensional_Consistency: DIMENSIONALLY RIGOROUS (All terms represent mass flux density [M L^-2 T^-1])
Physical_Validity_Notes: Harmonizes RACMO2.3p2 / MAR surface mass balance components. Runoff = melt - refreeze.

Equation_Name: 1D Shallow Shelf Equation with Basal and Lateral Drag (SSA-with-Drag, Option A)
Mathematical_Formula: - A_(i+1/2) * u_(i-1/2) + B_(i+1/2) * u_(i+1/2) - C_(i+1/2) * u_(i+3/2) = F_(i+1/2);   Control-Volume Integrated in [N]
LHS_Units_and_Meaning: N (Force in Newtons); A, B, C band coefficients in [N s m^-1 = kg s^-1] multiplied by velocity [m s^-1]
RHS_Terms_Units_and_Meaning: F_(i+1/2) = rho_i * g * (W * H)_(i+1/2) * (s_i - s_(i+1)) in [N]; driving force integrated over control volume
Spatial_Domain_Boundary: 1D flowline with width W(x) and bedrock z_b(x)
Dimensional_Consistency: DIMENSIONALLY RIGOROUS (All discrete terms evaluate strictly to Newtons [N] = kg m s^-2)
Physical_Validity_Notes: Control-volume integrated form in Newtons [N]. Coefficients A, C = 2*W*H*nu/Delta_x [N s m^-1]; B = A + C + D [N s m^-1]. Irreducibly diagonally dominant with Dirichlet boundaries; strictly diagonally dominant when drag D > 0. Thomas algorithm has non-zero pivots and is backward stable. Regularized via u_reg=1e-4 m/yr yielding beta_b(0) = 4.64e14 Pa s m^-1.

Equation_Name: Lateral Valley Sidewall Shear Stress & Drag Parameterization
Mathematical_Formula: tau_wall = [ (5 * u_bar) / (A * W) ]^(1 / n);   F_lat = 2 * H * tau_wall;   tau_bar_lat = (2 * H / W) * tau_wall
LHS_Units_and_Meaning: tau_wall in Pa (sidewall shear stress); F_lat in N m^-1 (force per unit flowline length); tau_bar_lat in Pa (cross-sectional drag stress)
RHS_Terms_Units_and_Meaning: H: ice thickness (m); W: channel width (m); u_bar: depth-averaged velocity (m s^-1); A: softness factor (Pa^-n s^-1); n: Glen exponent (3)
Spatial_Domain_Boundary: Flowline cells with confining bedrock valley walls (W < 20 km)
Dimensional_Consistency: DIMENSIONALLY RIGOROUS (tau_wall has units Pa; F_lat has units N m^-1 = Pa m; tau_bar_lat has units Pa)
Physical_Validity_Notes: Reduced-order scalar shear approximation (Whillans & van der Veen 1997; Pattyn 2006). Assumes horizontal pure shear eps_xy = 0.5*|du/dy| = A*tau_xy^n with parabolic wall gradient |du/dy|_wall = 10*u_bar/W, yielding tau_wall = [ 5*u_bar / (A*W) ]^(1/n). Uncoupled from longitudinal strain rate. Regularized near u=0 via u_reg.

Mathematical_Formula: m_dot_b = gamma_0 * ((rho_w * c_pw) / (rho_i * L_f))^2 * |Delta_T_ocean| * Delta_T_ocean * sin(alpha_draft)
LHS_Units_and_Meaning: m s^-1 (or m yr^-1); vertical melting rate at ice-shelf base
RHS_Terms_Units_and_Meaning: gamma_0: transfer velocity (m s^-1); c_pw: seawater heat capacity (J kg^-1 K^-1); L_f: latent heat (J kg^-1); Delta_T_ocean: thermal forcing (K); alpha_draft: draft slope
Physical_Validity_Notes: Quadratic local thermal driving model. Does not enter grounded ice continuity directly; drives buttressing decay.
